title: Six block-aware elimination orders
original_requirement: Run six monomial/variable/block orders on fixed descent cells; measure D and Macaulay size.
acceptance_criteria: Natural, reversed, interleaved, two block-elimination directions and weighted grevlex on byte-identical systems.
Exact solution/consequence agreement, D, rows, columns, nnz, peak RSS, counted work and time.
Order implementation respects actual monomial-order semantics; variable permutations alone are labeled as such.
remaining_gaps: Boolean engines hard-code leading-bit/rank assumptions; six-order adapter and order-aware monomial indexing are absent from inspected CLI.
Need immutable order-independent system export and full certificate checks for every order.
execution_note: Commands are source bindings, not launch receipts; preserve original trials and output to a fresh location through the applicable runner. No official approval or status transition is implied.
original_audit_text: Monomial, variable and block elimination orders tuned to the descent block structure. Your literature frontier found no prior work, and the engines run fixed grevlex. Six orders on fixed cells, measuring D and Macaulay size.
